item.content:encoded:
I'm sorry, I JUST noticed this discussion thread after it had been up for almost a month, and I have to say it made my day.

Anyway, with the Clef thing, I honestly didn't think about it, it was really just meant to be an amusing little blurb in an otherwise dark and serious SCP.

I would say that it just isn't an effective use of resources to keep Clef there 24/7, especially when there is sometimes a gap of several years between instances of SCP-567-9 appearing. Typically most of the casualties are TF Delta-9 members, who, while useful, are easily replaced.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I can see that once Clef leave after a long time all cell doors open at the same time and a steady stream of highly dangeous monsters would come out of every single door.
